description: Extract structured JSON from videos with a template (buyer-guide, tutorial-steps, comparison, summary, brief) or your own JSON Schema. The answer is validated against the schema (one repair attempt), and every citation ({videoId, startSec, quote}) is checked against the transcript: verified ones gain a title and timestamp url, failed ones are removed and listed in "unverified".

schema.description: A JSON Schema (type, properties, required, items, enum, min/max limits). The result is {data, citations}.

template.description: Template id; default summary when no schema is given

urls.description: Up to 25 video URLs or ids

name: extract
title: Extract structured data
